name: Armored Pale Crucible Hunter
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: native transparent static side-view creature sprite.
Primary request: ONE original Armored Pale Crucible Hunter.
Input image 1: base identity, anatomy, ivory palette and shaded game-sprite style reference only; use its intact crouched top-row posture. Ignore the sheet layout.
Subject: pale ivory-beige slender organic quadrupedal hunter with elongated smooth cranium, sharply ribbed narrow torso, small angular dorsal projections, two very long thin clawed forelimbs, two bent digitigrade hind legs and ONE long fine segmented curved tail. Retain its slender crouching proportions and warm pale shell over gray-beige recesses.
Variant lock: Original systemic armored variant: preserve the exact base anatomy, equipment and silhouette family, with practical layered protection. Organic creatures have natural carapace plates, not mechanical suits. People retain recognizable uniforms and equipment with additional guards. Preserve base identity colors and surface relief. No extra appendages or new weapons.
Integrate modest natural ivory chitin guards over the existing shoulders, ribs, forearms and shins, keeping a lean hunter rather than a heavy giant.
Composition: one whole static crouched ready stance facing RIGHT, side-three-quarter view with all FOUR limbs separated and countable. Full tail and tip, claws, feet, dome and dorsal points visible; 10% clear padding around the whole silhouette.
Background: actual transparent alpha only. No terrain, floor shadow, glow or environment.
No grid, sheet, duplicated character, text, logo, labels, border, crop, extra appendages, mechanical suit, weapons, wounds or gore. Original systemic project adaptation, not an official model or animation.
